🚨 Bitcoin is now BACK at the 200-week moving average.

This is one of the most important levels in Bitcoin’s entire history.

And what happened at this level during previous market cycles is extremely interesting.

Historically, the 200W moving average has acted as one of Bitcoin’s strongest long-term accumulation zones.

Here’s what happened in previous cycles.

• 2015: Bitcoin bottomed near the 200W moving average before entering a massive bull market.

• 2018: Bitcoin found support around this level before eventually recovering and reaching new all-time highs.

• 2020: Bitcoin briefly dropped below the 200W moving average during the COVID crash before starting its rally toward $69,000.

• 2022: Bitcoin broke below the 200W moving average and spent months trading around and below it before recovering in 2023.

And now, in 2026, Bitcoin is testing this historical level once again.

But here’s what makes this so interesting.

Every previous major bear market eventually created an enormous long-term buying opportunity around this indicator.

That doesn’t mean Bitcoin cannot fall further.

In fact, the 2022 bear market proved that Bitcoin can remain below the 200W moving average for an extended period.

But historically, investors who accumulated Bitcoin around these levels and held through the following cycle were rewarded.

And that’s why I’m watching this level so closely.
